records.assetReview: Geometry 4 px/cm: 10×20 cm fronts 40×80 px, third dimension 10 cm and horizontal face 1 dm². Surface y230; A faces y270/350 imply 10/30 cm, B faces y310/390 imply 20/40 cm. records.distractors: 40 N doubles the displaced mass; 2 is the mass number, not force. Body weight is unspecified and need not equal buoyancy.
records.manualArithmetic: The displaced fluid has mass (1 kg/L)(2 L)=2 kg; its weight is 20 N. A static fluid replacement requires an upward pressure resultant of that magnitude.
records.physicalAssumptions: Rigid closed impermeable volume fully immersed in homogeneous incompressible fluid at rest, g=10 m/s² uniform, no wall or bottom contact, capillary/air/support-volume effects neglected. Buoyancy alone is upward; body weight and support need not equal it. Different preparations may change fluid or body.
